item.title: Out of office: The Wallpaper* editors’ picks of the week
item.description: This week, the Wallpaper* editors have come over all European, setting their sights on Paris, Vienna and Brussels. Those left in London have been beating the January blues by uncovering new gems in familiar neighbourhoods or indulging in creature comforts at home

item.title: Gaudí’s Casa Batlló in Barcelona opens a mesmerising new contemporary art space
item.description: Welcome to Casa Batlló Contemporary, set within Antoní Gaudí’s landmark art nouveau house, courtesy of architects Mesura

item.title: Pascaline Chavanne on her dreamy costumes for new film Nouvelle Vague
item.description: The costume designer for Richard Linklater’s new film – about the making of Jean-Luc Godard’s 1960 classic Breathless – tells Wallpaper* about creating pieces that do ‘not disturb the story’

item.title: Wallpaper* Design Awards: Hermès reimagines the pool table
item.description: Hermès’ luxury American pool table, the ‘Off Piste 8 Feet’, is this year's best game changer

item.title: Who are the emerging artists to know in the UK now?
item.description: New Contemporaries’ annual exhibition in London and Middlesbrough spotlights 26 emerging and early-career artists working in the UK

item.title: Messika introduces the sleek new ‘Moderniste’ jewellery collection
item.description: Valérie Messika looks to the pure forms of modernist architecture for her brand’s contemporary new jewellery

item.title: DakaDaka brings 8,000 years of Georgian tradition to London
item.description: A new London restaurant distils Georgian hearth cooking and qvevri wine into a design-driven contemporary dining experience

item.title: A Neo-Georgian Islington house is a soothing retreat to unwind from the city
item.description: Designed collaboratively by Architecture for London and Hamish Vincent Design, this Islington House is defined by its natural material palette and a cascading spiral staircase

item.title: The Architecture Edit: Wallpaper’s houses of the month
item.description: These are the best architectural projects that Wallpaper* has profiled this month, from to a home sunken into a London garden to a 1960s modernist icon come to market

item.title: This rustic Montecito restaurant is all about impeccable taste in more ways than one
item.description: At Little Mountain, Chef Diego Moya leads a fire-lit restaurant that feels like dining at a friend’s home
